name: Chloe
source:
Chloe is a mysterious young girl from the town of Walton. Many rumours circle around town about her past, and as a result, she is a social outcast. The main rumour that people spread about her is that when she was young, she killed her [url=https://vndb.org/c131887]father[/url].

To cope with being an outcast, she has a tendency to read a lot and even got a job at the school library. She has a particular interest in fantasy novels and supernatural romance, her favourite series is the Stormlight Archive.

[In game description]
